scope: Qt Object detection responsiveness and result ownership; controlled model stand-ins, real Qt/NumPy/preparation/postprocessing/ledger paths.
changes: Toolbar model loading, input preparation, inference and enhancement finishing moved off Qt.
Captured parameters and ledger provenance; existing Cellpose cache and lock shared.
Late results rejected after field token, image identity/content or mask content changes.
Close detaches promptly; native inference is not forcibly interrupted.
Public synchronous run_cellpose contract retained; returns zero if toolbar detection already pending.

validation.skip: Optional real Cellpose E2E not enabled.
cases: Real Qt timer ticks while held inference runs on another thread.
Background model loading and image enhancement.
Single active toolbar request; direct call does not start another.
Navigation, mask edits, image replacement and in-place image changes reject results.
Inversion, percentile normalization and applied gamma match ordinary detector image, captured settings and ledger despite changed controls.
Close without waiting; late result suppressed.
Failure leaves mask untouched and permits retry.
Empty masks retain informative probability map.

limitations: No pretrained model inference speed or accuracy claim.
Existing direct programmatic run_cellpose remains synchronous.
Already executing native model call finishes in the background after close.
Source-bound API and translations handed to the separate documentation lane.
